proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived an informal matched all-design/all-estimator hard-cap frontier for bounded endpoint schedules, transferred it exactly to the published q=infinity class, and enlarged the degree window to d <= n^(1/5)/log n. The math referee passed and all four cited theorems were verified-attested, but the authoritative novelty assessment capped the result at subfield (paper-score ceiling 7 below 7.4), unsalvageable at the field floor within this scope. The valid duplicate theorem remains frozen with the reviewed graph and is disclosed as noncausal ballast; the q=2 frontier, scalable implementation, and informative finite-sample evaluation remain open, and no Lean formalization or certification was attempted.
tldr: For isolated direct effects under arbitrary neighborhood interference, the revealed-network all-design, all-estimator minimax risk on the published \(q=\infty\) endpoint class is \(\min\{1,B^{-1}+d/(n\log d)\}\), uniformly for integer degrees \((\log n)^2\le d\le n^{1/5}/\log n\) with \(nd\) even, and simultaneously over every public cap \(1\le B\le\lfloor n/2\rfloor\). The computable certificate permits \(|\operatorname{Tri}(G)|^2\log d\le nd\): triangle deletion is spent at its actual causal squared-bias scale \(d/(n\log d)\). Its deletion failure probability is at most \(4/(\log n)^2\). The unrestricted order on the same graph is \(d/(n\log d)\), the cap price is \(1+n\log d/(dB)\), and consistency is equivalent to \(B\to\infty\). Exact endpoint erasure transfers the bounded proof kernel to the endpoint-only class. The core changes the attaining design only; target and observations remain on the original graph. The larger \(q=2\) empirical-second-moment gap remains open.
gap: Corollary 5.3 of Kandiros, Harshaw and S\"avje leaves a logarithmic random-regular isolated-DTE risk sandwich over endpoint second-moment classes. The globally bounded invitation-outcome restriction defines a narrower precision question. Unrestricted exposure completion does not certify feasibility under an almost-sure cap, and bounded SUTVA theory does not control interference covariance.
fill: The explicit target \(r(n,d,B)=\min\{1,B^{-1}+d/(n\log d)\}\) fixes the content of the matched all-procedure claim. A certified triangle deletion, compatible coverage and signed covariance, and cap conversion support a realizable attainer. The graph event is a theorem target, while the cap price and the primitive consistency criterion concern the same revealed graph and endpoint schedules.
